issues.jp_before: 彼[かれ]{は|wa-topic}家族[かぞく]{に|ni-recipient}{まで/さえ|made-even}その話[はなし]{を|o-object}しませんでした。
issues.problem: Negative sentence: さえ is the natural choice there and まで sounds marked, so まで should not be the best answer. ばかり was a weak distractor.
issues.action: Rewrote it as an affirmative sentence: 家族にまで嘘をつきました ('He lied even to his family'). Changed the に slot to ni-target and the distractors to だけ/こそ/しか.

issues.jp_before: 先生[せんせい]{に|ni-recipient}{まで/さえ|made-even}文句[もんく]{を|o-object}言[い]う{なんて|nanka-nante}、ひどい{ね|ne-agreement}。
issues.problem: The why said 'you would not complain even to the teacher', which gets the sentence's meaning wrong.
issues.action: Rewrote the why: the complaining goes as far as the teacher.

issues.jp_before: 毎日[まいにち]、漢字[かんじ]{を|o-object}五[いつ]つ{ずつ|zutsu-each}覚[おぼ]えています。
issues.problem: The English 'Every day I learn five kanji at a time' was unnatural and did not match the meaning (five per day).
issues.action: Changed the English to 'I learn five new kanji each day.'

issues.jp_before: この本[ほん]{は|wa-topic}一日[いちにち]{に|ni-frequency}十[じゅう]ページ{ずつ|zutsu-each}読[よ]むつもりです。
issues.problem: The distractor も (一日に十ページも読む, 'as many as ten pages a day') is grammatical and only adds emphasis, so it is not plainly wrong for the English.

issues.jp_before: エレベーター{に|ni-destination}五人[ごにん]{ずつ|zutsu-each}入[はい]ってください。
issues.problem: エレベーターに入る is less natural than 乗る. The catalog puts 入る and 乗る に under ni-target, not ni-destination.
issues.action: Changed the verb to 乗ってください, the に skill to ni-target, and the English to 'get on'.

issues.jp_before: 母[はは]{は|wa-topic}洗濯物[せんたくもの]{を|o-object}一人[ひとり]分[ぶん]{ずつ|zutsu-each}分[わ]けました。
issues.problem: The English was awkward. The distractor ごと is close to an acceptable 一人分ごと(に)分ける.
issues.action: Changed the English to 'sorted the laundry into a separate pile for each person' and replaced ごと with ほど.
